attchmntText: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper advertisement of its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 18.01 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net profit of 83.02 lakh rupees in the same period of the previous year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company recorded a net profit of 13.80 lakh rupees, compared to 38.63 lakh rupees in the prior year. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. The announcement also includes an extension for E-Tender Notice No. 37 of 2026 by Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation, revising the availability of blank e-tender documents from November 13, 2026, to November 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 18.01 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net profit of 83.01 lakhs in the same period of 2025. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 13.80 lakhs, down from 38.63 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 2,919.99 lakhs for the quarter and 7,879.74 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative 0.00 for the quarter and 0.00 for the half year. The statutory auditors have carried out a limited review of these results.
